args.title: Partial refunds API
args.content: Started the partial refunds endpoint. The admin screen sends a list of order_item ids; the API sums their prices in pence, checks the total against the remaining capture and calls POST /v2/payments/{id}/partial-refunds. Sandbox refunds only work on payments from yesterday, so the tests use a fixture payment dated the day before. Next: the item picker in the admin screen.

# Model Handoff

Last updated by Claude on 2 November 2026.

## Where we are

- Partial refunds API is in progress: the endpoint sums order_item prices and calls PayLoop. The admin item picker is not started.
- The Welsh launch is still waiting on the translator (allergen labels and email templates, due 6 November). Launch date: 13 November.
- The basket button contrast fix is merged.

## Watch out for

- PayLoop sandbox partial refunds only work on payments from a previous day.
- Staging and production share the VPS. Restart only fernhill-api-staging when testing.

## Suggested next steps

1. Build the item picker for partial refunds.
2. Rerun the load test after refunds land.
3. Ask Leo about Saturday deliveries to CF5.
